metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds a bad rehearsal of the old Knave, eight lines got right, and a queen left at a hedge.

yesterday: Cowley dried four times in the same place. He apologised to four men.
Pope was padded to a barrel. Sincler had a doublet that fits a rake. You were thanked for eight lines, and the thanks were sarcastic.
They broke at eleven. The Rose has Hercules again.
The queen is still at the hedge.
